title: MaintenanceIncident
description: One observation that the maintenance agent of a node reports: a service that should run and does not, a manifest that does not parse, a health check that fails. The wire form is the one the agent writes, with camelCase names. The text fields arrive already redacted and redactionLevel says so; a consumer that stores or forwards incidents refuses raw unless its configuration allows it. schema_version is optional so that an incident written before the contract existed still validates. The schema is closed.

severity.description: What was observed, not a prediction of impact: critical means a service that should run does not.

component.description: The service, unit or file concerned.

evidenceRefs.description: Where the evidence can be found.

redactionLevel.description: sanitized when the text fields are redacted.

requestedBy.description: Who asked for the observation, or null when the agent did it on its own.

correlationId.description: Shared by the incidents of one collection pass.
